# Audex Trace

Audex Trace is a macOS Apple Music mini player for Lossless and Hi-Res listeners.

Official site: https://trace.audex.dev/

Download: https://github.com/audexdev/trace-releases/releases/download/v1.0/AudexTrace-1.0.zip

Release notes: https://github.com/audexdev/trace-releases/releases/tag/v1.0

Current version: 1.0

Minimum macOS version: macOS 15

Primary supported player: Apple Music on macOS

Key features:
- Apple Music mini player for macOS
- Playback format readout for codec, bit depth, and sample rate
- Output sample-rate match status
- Experimental Auto Sample Rate Match
- Menu bar and notch player views
- Built-in Compatibility Check before purchase

Pricing:
- Free download
- Audex Trace Pro launch offer: $19.99 one-time purchase
- Regular price: $24.99 one-time purchase
- No subscription

Known limitations:
- Apple Music Song Transitions, AutoMix, or Crossfade can make playback-format detection delayed or unavailable around track changes.
- Auto Sample Rate Match depends on the output device exposing compatible macOS sample rates.
- macOS 14 and earlier are not officially supported in Audex Trace 1.0.

Privacy summary:
- Playback format detection runs locally using Music.app state and local playback metadata/log signals.
- Audex Trace does not modify, enhance, record, or upload audio.
- License verification, update checks, purchase checkout, and artwork fallback may use the network.
